field_some_features: Only some of the features have it
issue_unreadable_level: {key}={value} can't be read. Use numbers like 0, -1, 0.5, lists like 0;1 or ranges like 0-2.
issue_unreadable_level_comma: {key}={value} can't be read. Separate levels with ; (e.g. 0;1) and write decimals with . (e.g. 0.5).
issue_vertical_repeat_on: Stairs and elevators connect levels: list them all in level, not in repeat_on.
issue_door_not_on_wall: This door is not on a wall or room outline, so routing can't go through it.
plan_tool_click_plan_first: Click a spot on the plan first.
plan_tool_measure_on_plan: Click on the plan to measure.
plan_tool_pivot_on_plan: Click on the plan to pick the centre of rotation.
plan_storage_restore_failed: Saved floor plans could not be restored: {error}
plan_storage_save_failed: Floor plans could not be saved in this browser: {error}
plan_import_unsupported: IndoorID can import PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG and PDF plans, and plan files (.zip, or .json from earlier versions).
plan_import_map_not_ready: The map is not ready yet.
plan_import_image_unreadable: This image could not be read.
plan_import_image_too_large: This image is too large to import (over 100 megapixels). Scale it down first.
plan_import_svg_unreadable: This SVG drawing could not be read.
plan_import_pdf_unreadable: This PDF could not be read.
plan_file_not_json: This file is not a floor plan file (not JSON).
plan_file_unknown: This file is not an IndoorID or OsmInEdit floor plan file.
plan_file_no_image: A floor plan in this file has no image.
plan_file_damaged: A floor plan in this file is damaged or incomplete.
plan_file_too_large: This floor plan file is too large to open.
plan_file_newer: This floor plan file was made by a newer version of IndoorID: update IndoorID to open it.
login_popup_closed: The login window was closed before you logged in.
login_timed_out: Logging in took too long. Try again.
upload_too_many_changes: {count} features changed: a changeset takes at most {max}. Upload part of your edits first.
